road network, travel times and route geometry

provenance.description: One frozen scenario of the public Montbéliard demonstration (its baseline's sample 1): 20 drivers and 30 riders whose trips are sampled from the Registre de Preuve de Covoiturage open data (data.gouv.fr, release 2026-10), on the OpenStreetMap road network of the Pays de Montbéliard; departures 07:00-09:00; detour at most 15 min and 50 % of the direct trip; vehicle profiles and the emission configuration of the demonstration.

participants.method: drivers and riders drawn independently from the empirical OD/departure distribution; departures re-drawn within the 10-minute rounding interval

road_network.travel_model: free-flow travel times from the OSM speed profile
